breaking.member: MainMenuScreen, PauseScreen, SettingsScreen, GameOverScreen, LoadingScreen, CreditsScreen, TitleScreen
breaking.change: Each screen stands on Backdrop: with no key art the menus, title, loading and credits show the pack's designed ground, never a flat colour; pause, settings and game over lay one veil over the game. Each shows a HintBar footer. The main menu and pause menu stack their heading, objective and menu as one vertically centred column in MenuList.frame; settings rows are 56 px with the value shown, tabs take an icon and the description sits under the list; game over sets the score in Screen.figure over one centred column of actions; credits' role labels are 18 px and Back is a hint (a button on touch).
breaking.fix: A game that placed its own content against the former layouts checks its screens; one that wants a former layout copies the screen's source.

breaking.change: A page is { id, name, icon? }: the icon is drawn before the tab's name.
breaking.fix: Pass an icon set's name in `icon` for a page that should show one.

breaking.change: The card is at most 480 px wide and centred, with a rarity band and its frame in Card.rarity; its labels, compare columns and change chips are larger.
breaking.fix: A layout that gave the card a wider column gets the card centred in it.
